scholarship_title: UNIMORE 'Top Student' Fee Exemption for First-Year Master's Students
provider_organization: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia (UNIMORE)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Full first-year fee exemption for students living outside Emilia-Romagna (pay only EUR 159.67 fixed costs); partial for Emilia-Romagna residents (EUR 859.67 total)

stipend.notes: No stipend; fee exemption only. Not means-tested.

application_fee.notes: No fee mentioned for the exemption request.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: Bachelor's (three-year degree or university diploma) completed with 110/110

required_documents.name: Online request on the ER.GO portal ('ESONERO TOP STUDENT')
required_documents.detail: Log in with SPID, CIE or CNS; choose total exemption if you do not live in Emilia-Romagna

preparation_alerts: The online request needs an Italian digital identity (SPID, CIE or CNS), which most applicants abroad only get after arriving
Apply before enrolling, by the deadline

selection_criteria.pass_rule: Automatic if you meet the 110/110 rule and apply in time

source_urls.title: UNIMORE International: fees and flat tax for non-EU students
source_urls.used_for: Exclusions (previous master's enrolment) per search results

verification_status.verification_notes: The official page text refers to freshmen enrolling in 2025/2026 but gives the deadline as 22 Dec 2026 16:00; this mismatch needs a human check. It is not stated how a foreign bachelor's grade is converted to 110/110, so international applicants may not qualify in practice; min_grade_percent 100 reflects 110/110. UNIMORE also has a flat-tax scheme for non-EU students (not researched). Status set to open because the stated deadline is in the future and the exemption is requested at enrolment.
